title: LES JUPES, they call them in Belgium
html_source:
“Les Jupes” means the skirts in french, and in Belgium, French is one of the two primary languages. (the other being Dutch)

The director appears to be quite offended by the idea of a skirt (“this thing up about their knees”), especially while cycling. Maybe he’s just sensitive about that kind of thing…
